title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 未来展望 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）
meta: 主题语境：未来展望（宇宙探索·未来与展望）　|　核心词汇：universe　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 universe 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the observer ① studyed the universe that no assistant in the observatory would have noted, and he said the studying was the whole of the night. The ② universe, meaning the cosmos itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed unnoted in the book; a universe, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ universe in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ universe at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A universe, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the observer said the noting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the universe was the whole of the matter, meaning the mystery and not the cosmos. The ⑥ universe, meaning the mystery and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; universe, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a cosmos and a mystery. He said the mystery is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ universe had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ universe of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of noting; universe, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ universe I remember is the cosmos noted in the log, which closed in 1984 and is still noted as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ universe, my mother said in 1986, is the only cosmos that improves by being noted; every universe, she said, is a mystery that has agreed to look like a cosmos. She said the mystery was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 宇宙（指观测站里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 宇宙（指那个宇宙本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the universe 探究这一个宇宙
D. n. 宇宙（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 宇宙之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的宇宙之事）
F. n. 宇宙（指观测记录里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 宇宙、奥妙（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 奥妙（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the universe that no assistant in the observatory would have noted
The universe, meaning the cosmos itself and not the lens
the universe at the far dome
the universe was the whole of the matter
the universe had become a line in a log
The universe of the whole thing
A universe, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: study the universe 意为“探究这一个宇宙”，1977 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯记下的一个宇宙做了一遍。
universe 意为“宇宙”，指那个宇宙本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。
universe 意为“宇宙”，指观测站里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
universe 意为“宇宙”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
universe 意为“宇宙、奥妙”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个奥妙就是那件事的全部。
universe 意为“奥妙”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个宇宙，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
universe 意为“宇宙”，指观测记录里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1982 年这一个成了观测记录里的一行。
universe 意为“宇宙之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的宇宙之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的记下。
universe 意为“宇宙”，我记得的是观测记录里记下过的那一个，1984 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一个。
universe 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，宇宙是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的宇宙。
